name: CE_RECON_MATCHING_RULES
description: CE_RECON_MATCHING_RULES contains reconciliation matching rules that are used during automatic reconciliation.

columns.name: RECON_MATCHING_RULE_ID
columns.description: System generated primary key that identifies the matching rule.

columns.name: MATCHING_RULE_NAME
columns.description: Name of the reconciliation matching rule.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description of the reconciliation matching rule.

columns.name: ACTIVE_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate whether this is an active matching rule.

columns.name: AP_SOURCE_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate whether this rule will be used to reconcile payables transactions.

columns.name: AR_SOURCE_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate whether this rule will be used to reconcile receivables transactions.

columns.name: CE_SOURCE_FLAG
columns.description: Not currently used.

columns.name: EXT_SOURCE_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate whether this rule will be used to reconcile cash management external transactions.

columns.name: PAY_SOURCE_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate whether this rule will be used to reconcile payroll transactions.

columns.name: MATCH_TYPE
columns.description: Matching type of the rule. For example,  one to one matching, one to many matching, many to one matching, or many to many matching.

columns.name: JOIN_CONDITION
columns.description: Join condition formed from the match criteria.

columns.name: STMT_GROUPBY
columns.description: Group by clause on the bank statement line side. It is used in automatic reconciliation.

columns.name: TRX_GROUPBY
columns.description: Group by clause on the system transaction side.  It is used in automatic reconciliation.

columns.name: AMOUNT_MATCH_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate whether this rule should match on amount.

columns.name: DATE_MATCH_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate whether this rule should match on date.

columns.name: TYPE_MATCH_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate whether this rule should match on transaction type.

columns.name: REFERENCE_ID_MATCH_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate whether this rule should match on reconciliation reference.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: GL_SOURCE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether this rule is used to reconcile journal entry lines.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
